generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Let users inspect, export, retain, or delete personal settings and supplied data and manage consent for message-derived information.

contract.purpose_user_function: Current code offers local backup/restore, keep-data versus deletion on uninstall, selected content redaction, secret-safe config helpers, and repository privacy scans; it is not a unified personal-data control center.
contract.valid_inputs: solar backup/restore/uninstall flags and archive paths, local config/secrets/database, ingestion text subject to redaction, and environment-backed notification/guardian identifiers.
contract.expected_outputs: Backup archive, restored local data, retained or removed Solar data, redacted ingestion artifacts, neutral privacy/config values, and privacy-scan pass/fail evidence.
contract.state_side_effects: Backup creates an archive containing selected config/secrets/receipt/database; restore writes data; uninstall deletes or retains user data according to --keep-data; ingestion redaction changes exported text.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Uninstall refuses without --yes, dry-run avoids deletion, missing archive fails restore, privacy scan fails on tracked owner-identifying tokens, and absent identity env values use neutral fallbacks.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: No UI/API for data-subject inspection/export scope, retention schedules, selective deletion, consent records, or revocation of message-derived consent was found.
contract.success_evidence: bin/solar: do_backup, do_restore and uninstall; docs/UNINSTALL.md: Keep your data/Back up before removing; core/config/privacy.ts; scripts/check-privacy.sh; harness/lib/apple_notes_ingest.py: redact.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Backup contents and permissions; restore; uninstall delete versus keep-data/dry-run; neutral secret-free fallback; content redaction/full override; privacy scan positive/negative; unsupported consent and selective-retention paths.
contract.readme_product_docs: docs/UNINSTALL.md: What gets removed, Keep your data, Dry run and Back up before removing; INSTALL.md: config.env/.env and Lifecycle; AGENTS.md: privacy scan requirement.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: bin/solar: backup, restore, uninstall --keep-data/--dry-run; scripts/check-privacy.sh; no dedicated personal-data/consent API found.
contract.config_schemas: core/config/privacy.ts environment-backed notification/guardian identifiers; install receipt/config layout in INSTALL.md; no consent or retention schema found.
contract.implementation_entrypoints: bin/solar do_backup/do_restore/uninstall; core/config/privacy.ts getters; harness/lib/apple_notes_ingest.py redact; scripts/check-privacy.sh.
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Controls operate on local Solar-managed files only; external provider/OS credential stores and data held by message platforms are outside current implementation.

implementation.entrypoints: bin/solar do_backup/do_restore/uninstall; core/config/privacy.ts getters; harness/lib/apple_notes_ingest.py redact; scripts/check-privacy.sh.
